Intro akash.mp4.summary: In this recording, Akars Kumar provides a concise self‑introduction, detailing his current enrollment in a BTEC program for Computer Science and IoT at Node Institute of Engineering and Technology, alongside a minor degree in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning from Sam College. He mentions completing his primary and secondary education in his hometown of Vagalpur. Kumar highlights his interest in programming, citing proficiency in C, Python, and Java, and describes practical experience gained through projects such as web page cloning, e‑commerce (Amazon) and streaming (Netflix) replicas, mobile gaming and quiz applications, and IoT initiatives like an automated greenhouse. He also references a published research paper on the automated greenhouse and a three‑month intensive program by AICTC, as well as a machine‑learning project involving multi‑taxi routing. The tone remains confident and forward‑looking, emphasizing both academic and hands‑on technical achievements.
